ashes-urhrok.note: The manifest fixes the extracted Ashes snapshot identity, but does not fix the public Ashes source repository, commit, version, or revision. The cited file hashes are frozen observations, not a pinned DLC revision.

runtime_conclusion.summary: FIREBURN treats its dam input as the total damage of the complete event, not damage per turn.

engine_anchor.evidence: The projector defaults dur to 3 and initial to 50, applies init_dam = dam * perc / 100 immediately, then assigns the remainder to EFF_BURNING with power = remaining dam / dur.

burning_anchor.evidence: The effect projects eff.power each timeout; on_merge preserves remaining-plus-new damage before recomputing per-turn power.

samples.verified_target: 目标被一层魔法护盾包围，吸收 %d/%d 伤害，护盾结束时（无论吸收耗尽还是自然到期），引燃持续 3 回合、总计造成 %d 伤害且范围为半径 %d 的灼烧。
samples.answer: Yes in the frozen target: the third %d was described as damage each turn. The verified target makes it the total damage of the full three-turn FIREBURN event.

source_anchors.evidence: long_desc binds the third %d to eff.power; deactivate always projects FIREBURN with dur=3 and dam=spellCrit(eff.power). Shield exhaustion removes the effect, while normal expiry also reaches deactivate.

history.original_target_before_delivery: 目标被一层魔法护盾包围，吸收 %d/%d 伤害，护盾破碎时造成 %d 伤害（半径 %d）。
history.assessment: The pre-12626757 target did not say that the displayed total was dealt each turn, so it did not have the same total-vs-per-turn defect. Its separate problems were that it described only a shield-breaking trigger and characterized the outcome as one damage event, omitting natural expiry and the three-turn burn.
